notes.title: Masternoid Demo Updated
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 New Update Alert! 🚀[/h1]
Hey Masternoid Players!

We have some thrilling news! We've just rolled out our first update to the Masternoid Demo.
Get ready to show off your skills in Daily Blast!

[h2]🎮 Daily Blast Mode[/h2]

[b]Daily Challenge[/b]
Each day brings a new level to compete with your friends and the world.

[b]One Shot, One Score[/b]
The pressure is on with just one attempt to set your high score. Every block counts!

[b]Global Rankings[/b]
Climb to the top of the leaderboard and be the king of the day! Bragging rights included!

We can't wait to see who will dominate the Daily Blast leaderboards!
Jump in now and show us what you've got.

Thank you for your support and happy blasting!

All the best,
The Masternoid Crew
